brief: A 30-second promo for my cafe in Persian, logo attached (~/logo.png), warm colors.
requirements: the promo is in Persian: language fa (the request is written in English but the piece is Persian — the language verifier ASR-checks the mix)
Persian on-screen text is shaped right-to-left (correctly joined glyphs, RTL alignment — the captions service with Vazirmatn does fa shaping; no tofu, no LTR rendering)
narration in Persian if the promo is narrated (an fa voice — the fa_IR voice exists; a text-only promo is a stated choice, not an accident)
the logo ~/logo.png is the brand element (used on screen — the closing brand card; a human-supplied asset; it is missing: flagged, never invented or replaced by a drawn logo)
warm colors: the design system is a warm palette (oranges, reds, ambers in design.json; subjective — critic evidence)
a promo arc: a fast hook, the cafe's mood or feel, a closing brand card with the logo (a motion-graphics ad, not a slideshow)
sound: one mix at the loudness target (a music bed cue-synced to the motion; licensed or made here — no unlicensed track)
no format was named: the plan states its assumption (a promo suggests 9:16 vertical; whichever it picks is written down)
no invented cafe facts (no made-up name, menu, prices or address: the brand truth is the logo, and it is missing — placeholders are marked as assumptions)
must_not: inventing the logo or the cafe's name, menu and details (~/logo.png is the brand truth and it is missing: flagged; placeholders are assumptions, never invented facts)
a capability set that cannot shape RTL Persian text (plain LTR rendering, tofu or unjoined glyphs fail the ask — the captions service + Vazirmatn do fa RTL shaping)
English on-screen copy (the request is written in English but the promo is in Persian: fa copy, fa narration, RTL alignment)
a cool or neutral palette against 'warm colors' (the design system must be warm — oranges, reds, ambers)
edit as the base technique (no cafe footage exists — only the missing logo: the promo is code-drawn)
